entries.t: Webworm Suspected of Modifying SoftEther VPN to Evade Detection and Hide Remote Access
entries.sum: The China-aligned threat actor known as Webworm is suspected to be using a custom version of the open-source SoftEther VPN Bridge tool in an attempt to remove recognizable detection fingerprints, while disguising it as network-monitoring software to establish covert remote access to compromised networks. entries.t: Bots exploited leaked AWS key from Docker image in under 8 seconds
entries.sum: A cloud access key left inside a newly published Docker image can be found and used by bots in less than eight seconds, Billy Tsouvalas and Nick Nikiforakis of Stony Brook University discovered after planting 300 decoy images on public container registries. Docker images are packaged copies of software, bundled with everything needed to run it, and developers publish them to public registries such as Docker Hub…
